dataset_name: HERITAGE QUEST — Egypt Accessible Heritage Starter Dataset
scope: Pilot dataset focused on Cairo/Giza heritage locations; not a comprehensive national database.

currency.disclaimer_en: USD ticket equivalents are indicative conversions, not prices charged in USD. EGP prices and currency rates can change; official ticketing channels take precedence.
currency.disclaimer_ar: القيم المقابلة بالدولار تحويلات تقريبية وليست أسعارًا محصلة بالدولار. قد تتغير أسعار الجنيه وسعر الصرف؛ وتُقدَّم قنوات الحجز الرسمية على هذه البيانات.

data_quality_rules: Coordinates in this starter set are approximate map pins and must be checked against official entrance locations before public launch.
Accessibility features are shown only where a cited source explicitly lists them; unknown is not equivalent to inaccessible.
Conflicting ticket price records must not be shown to public users until a current price is confirmed.
Hospital records marked HOLD/provisional must not be shown as confirmed recommendations until contact details, services, operating status, and accessibility features have been verified.
Tour-marketplace prices are examples, not guaranteed offers; provider must confirm group size, inclusions, availability, vehicle suitability, step-free routes, and date-specific cost.
For emergencies in Egypt, call the emergency provider directly; the website is not a medical service.

summary.en: A major museum dedicated to ancient Egyptian civilization, near the Giza Pyramids.
summary.ar: متحف رئيسي مخصص للحضارة المصرية القديمة، بالقرب من أهرامات الجيزة.

opening_hours.en: Complex: Sun/Tue/Thu/Fri 08:30–19:00; Wed/Sat 08:30–22:00. Galleries: 09:00–18:00 on regular days; 09:00–21:00 Wed/Sat. Check official site before visiting.

accessibility.summary_en: Officially states wheelchair access, ramps, lifts, wide pathways, wheelchairs, golf carts, accessible restrooms, seating/rest points and a tactile/Braille replica. Visitors with disabilities are listed as exempt from admission fees; verify proof/booking conditions with the museum.
